build_marian_tokenizer: build a MarianTokenizer instance from source and target SentencePiece models with separate vocabularies for translation
tokenize_text_marian: tokenize source and target text sequences into token ids using MarianTokenizer for machine translation
decode_token_ids: decode token ids back into readable strings using MarianTokenizer with optional source or target tokenizer
save_tokenizer_vocab: save MarianTokenizer vocabulary and SentencePiece model files to a specified directory
get_special_tokens_mask: get a mask identifying special tokens like eos and pad in a token id sequence for MarianTokenizer
